subject: Otyugh
picture: An otyugh sits in a dungeon refuse pit. Fat potato body, three thick legs, two long tentacles growing from the sides of the body, one eyestalk with two eyes on top. A simple toothy mouth on the front of the body with nothing coming out of it. Large sacks and bones as refuse. Stone pit rim, ceiling, walls. Bold even black outlines on white, same look as locked I-01 and I-02. All-ages, no gore.
